config.style: half-timbered Tudor cottage: brick lower band + plaster upper with dark timber studs/rails, slate gable roof with ridge cap, brick chimney, 4 mullioned windows, open 4x7 timber-framed doorway

steps: get_references (stone/thatch cottages) - noted gable roof, chimney, mullioned windows, mixed brick+plaster materials
built walls as brick band (0-4) + plaster band (4-10) around 26x18 footprint, wood-plank floor
added WedgePart gable triangles + two angled slate roof slabs meeting at a verified ridge (y=16) with ridge cap and eave overhang
added open doorway (4w x 7h, physically verified clear) with timber lintel/jambs, 4 windows with glass+mullions, timber stud/rail grid, corner posts, brick chimney+cap
capture_angles front/right/iso, fixed gable wedge orientation, roof-plane ridge gap, and window z-fighting, re-captured to confirm

recipe.text: Assembled 60+ anchored primitives at (90,90) on the baseplate. Key fixes from vision loop: wedge gables needed 180-deg yaw flip (slope faced outward), roof slabs rebuilt with CFrame.lookAt(mid,ridge) so both planes meet at the ridge, windows nudged +0.45z out of the wall to stop z-fighting, and the low front timber rail split around the doorway so the opening is walkable. Distinct from prior structure-house artifacts by its half-timbered Tudor style.
